notes.title: Stardrytch Out Now
notes.notes: Good news! It's finally done, Stardrytch is now available for purchase! If you buy it in the first week, you will get a 15% discount. Take this opportunity and get it now!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest ends - thank you for your interest.
notes.notes:
Hi adventurers,

I want to thank everybody who is showing interest for Stardrytch. I hope you enjoyed Steam Next Fest, tried many diffrent demos and wishlisted a bunch of games! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034484/cac7cfbad5999d27d17bd3df8ef368d9d42618b4.png[/img]

With Steam Next Fest concluded I will disable my own demo tomorrow, so I can try and make the demo expirence even better. My work on the full version of Stardrytch continues. I'm looking forward to releasing the game next month. 

Stay tuned!

Best regards,

Nils Kastens

notes.title: Stardrytch Demo Live!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow adventurers, 

the Stardrytch Demo is now playable! Play a level of the challenging indie action-platformer and explore an ancient, lost city. But be careful, the ruined city is full of heavily armored skeleton warriors. They will try to stop you!  Journey through a fascinating scenery, unlock a new ability and upgrade your gear. Run, fight and try not to die. Have fun!

If you enjoyed the demo remember to put the game on your wishlist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034484/db06664bb2269e7161cbf29c33a2e0b948f17fa2.png[/img]
[i]Make your way over the broken bridge to reach the city gates.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034484/4950e76edec898666fc45d40fa0967d1f5412195.png[/img]
[i]Shatter the resistance. Overcome your enemies.[/i]

notes.title: Stardrytch Steam Playtest Live NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow adventurers, 

the first Steam Playtest for Stardrytch is live! The test will be available for two weeks until the 27th of September. You can still sign up for the test. Additional participants will be granted access in the coming week.

The primary feedback I am looking for includes but is not limited to: 

- crashes and bugs 

- difficulty spikes 

- UI navigation problems

- getting stuck/lost in levels

You can leave your feedback on the Playtests community hub or send me an email at support@nils-kastens.com. Please include screenshots of relevant sections and your PC specifications if possible.

Thank you for your support and have fun!

notes.title: Stardrytch Steam Playtest Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow adventurers,

I proudly announce the first Steam Playtest for Stardrytch! The game is in a closed beta state right now and a Steam Playtest is scheduled for the 14th of September and will start at 6PM CEST.  If you are interested you can sign up for the test - starting on the 1st of September. The test will be active for two weeks (until the 27th of September) and the number of participants will be limited.

The primary feedback I am looking for includes but is not limited to: 

- crashes and bugs

- difficulty spikes

- UI navigation problems

- getting stuck/lost in levels 

You can leave your feedback on the Playtest's community hub or send me an email: 
support@nils-kastens.com

I am looking forward to hearing from you and am thankful for your support.
